defect_fix.before: try: () => handler(job, { attempt: info.attempts }) - thunk arity 0, so Effect.tryPromise allocated no AbortController; Effect.timeout interrupted the fiber and left the handler's Promise running.
defect_fix.after: try: (signal) => handler(job, { attempt: info.attempts, signal }) - thunk arity 1, so the vendored tryPromise supplies the AbortSignal and aborts it on interruption; the handler receives it as context.signal.
defect_fix.contract: QueueAttemptContext { attempt: number; signal?: AbortSignal } exported from workers.ts and used by all four worker option types and the queue-runtime option types.

cancellation_watch_f3.status: CLOSED with an explicitly stated observability limit
cancellation_watch_f3.abort_half: proved through the worker: the operator cancel (UPDATE effect_queue SET state='cancelled', acquired_at=NULL, acquired_by=NULL; the same statement as run101-r5-cancel-drain) makes the watch fail with QueueJobCancelledError, raceFirst interrupts the attempt, and the forwarded Effect AbortSignal fires inside the handler (asserted, not merely 'the fiber stopped').
cancellation_watch_f3.named_error_half: proved at the queue-take boundary the worker uses: the test composes the same attempt/watch raceFirst+timeout and asserts Exit.isFailure, Cause.hasInterruptsOnly === false, the failure is an instance of QueueJobCancelledError and its message names the job.
cancellation_watch_f3.why_not_through_the_worker: The claim loop deliberately swallows a non-interrupt cause (workers.ts catchCause -> Effect.sleep(250)) so the named error has no worker-level surface; and the operator cancel nulls acquired_by, so the store's failed/retry UPDATE (WHERE sequence=? AND acquired_by=<lock>) matches no row, leaving last_failure unset. Asserting a row readback or a worker callback for the class name would have been inventing a surface that does not exist.
cancellation_watch_f3.precedent: run101-r5-cancel-drain asserted only 'the cancelled handler did not run to completion' + row state; this follows the same operator mechanism and adds the signal/abort observation.
